spans.s:
nís, adv. prep.
 —1. out, forth;
 —2. in
cpds [1305^2 end], having…away, without…,
 e. g. nirantara; --3. in cpds, not,
e. g. niścala.

niścaya, m. (ascertainment, determination,
 i. e.) a fixed opinion or a firm resolve.
[poss. fr. √3 ci, ‘notice, look,’ + nis; but
better, perhaps, fr. √1ci + nis, and so,
‘an un-piling, i. e. discrimination, determination.
’]

niścala, a. not moving. [nis + cala: see
nis 3.]

niṣadha, m. pl. the Nishadhans, name of
[]
a people; Nishadha, name of a country,
1^7 N., 4^3.

niṣadhādhipa, m. ruler or king of the
Nishadhans. [adhipa.]

niṣūdana, m. finisher (in its colloquial
sense), one who makes an end of, destroyer.
 [√sūd + ni.]

niṣeka, m. an injecting, esp. of semen,
impregnation; the ceremony performed
upon impregnation. [√sic + ni.]

niṣevin, a. devoting one's self to; cohabiting
with, 67^22. [√sev + ni.]

niṣkramaṇa, n. the stepping out; esp.
the first going out with a child. [√kram
+ nis.]
